feedback:
Reviewed before racing, so no outcome is stated for this candidate. It changes one value from the best raced design (iteration 6, score 604.0): controller.line_loss from 'last_direction' to 'search_right', with kp 1.5, ki 0.02, kd 0.6, base_speed 1.2, sensor geometry and sensor_weights unchanged. All fields are within the contract ranges, and the single-variable change keeps any result attributable.

The evidence supports this test. Slalom line_loss_events have been 1.0 per run in every raced design since iteration 2 (iterations 4 to 6 at 1.0 across kp 1.7, 1.5 and kd 0.5, 0.6), so gain changes have not moved it. Iteration 6 slalom progress is 0.33 and every slalom run ends off track, so the lost-line recovery is the untested lever. The contract says search_right steers left with a fixed +1 signal, and the candidate's own rationale admits the direction is a gamble with no direct evidence. The change only affects lost-line segments, so oval finishes (18/20 in iteration 6) and s-bend should be broadly unchanged.

Risks: search_right may steer the wrong way on slalom bends, leaving slalom unchanged or worse. Also, s-bend steering_oscillation was 0.397 in iteration 6, right at the 0.4 guard, so kd 0.6 gives no margin. Read the race as follows. If slalom line_loss_events fall below 1.0 or slalom progress rises above 0.33, keep search_right and test base_speed 1.4 as the next single change. If slalom is unchanged or worse, do not change kp or kd. Test controller.line_loss 'search_left' with the same gains as a comparison, or a forward sensor shift to y 0.06 if line loss stays at 1.0 under both directions. If s-bend or oval steering_oscillation rises above 0.4 without a gain in line-loss events, revert kd to 0.5 (iteration 5 value).
requested_changes: If slalom line_loss_events fall below 1.0 or slalom progress rises above 0.33 with oval finishes near 18/20, keep controller.line_loss 'search_right' and test controller.base_speed 1.4 as the next single change, since iteration 6 shows speed becomes the limit once line loss is controlled.

If slalom line loss is unchanged or worse under search_right, do not change kp or kd; test controller.line_loss 'search_left' with kp 1.5 and kd 0.6 as a comparison, because the direction of recovery is untested (iterations 4 to 6 show slalom loss does not respond to gain).
If s-bend or oval steering_oscillation exceeds 0.4 (iteration 6 s-bend was 0.397) without a fall in line_loss_events, revert controller.kd to 0.5 with line_loss 'search_right', keeping kp 1.5.
